findings.issue: The story-level rationale of all five stories is “A fala descreve coceira na pele, compatível com Prurido geral e com a descrição cutânea; localização/relato não determina causa.”. That sentence belongs to the Prurido stories of the same batch (indices 10..19) and is false for utterances about weakness and lack of energy: none of them mentions itch or skin. In the app, story.rationale is not internal metadata: adaptInterviewRelease prepends it to contextExplanation, which the interrogatório feedback renders to the student. A student who answers Astenia correctly would be told that the utterance describes itch compatible with Prurido. The same string is on the five Astenia stories outside this review's scope (indices 35..39).

In both, the symptom word is strength (“Falta força”, “falta de força”), which the Fadiga description does not print, so Astenia remains the better fit and Fadiga is only partly met.

findings.resolution: Not supported in the reviewer's reading: the utterances report a general feeling of weakness of the whole person or body, not loss of muscle strength in a part of the body or difficulty moving it, and the source places Paresias among disorders of voluntary motricity. MeSH describes Paresis as a degree of muscular weakness and keeps it apart from Asthenia. The sibling batch avoids the overlap explicitly (“não só numa perna”, “Não é um braço que perdeu força”); a similar contrast would make these utterances safer but is not required.

findings.issue: MeSH (D001247) descreve Asthenia como “Clinical sign or symptom manifested as debility, or lack or loss of strength and energy”, e mantém Fatigue (D005221) como descritor separado (“state of weariness following a period of exertion, mental or physical…”). A classificação aqui é descritiva e fonte-específica: não certifica causa, gravidade, duração clínica nem diagnóstico.
findings.resolution: Source-based descriptive recognition only. This is not symmetrical with batch-005, where persistent “sem energia” met the whole general Astenia description and Fadiga stories were held.
